name: CHIMERA
description: A physically modeled voice: every sound comes from a simulated airway (lungs, vocal folds, tongue, lips, nose), not samples. Sing typed lyrics a syllable per key, shape vowels by hand, beatbox on the pads, or play a songbird, seal, alligator or elephant. Port of jamesondh's CHIMERA engine, lightened to run on the Move.
author: legsmechanical (engine: Jameson Hodge / CHIMERA)
